Cornish scholar

Eldest son of the Rt.

Rev.

Henry Jenner and Mary Isabel Finlaison, pioneer student of Cornish, assistant in the MS department of the British Museum.

He married Katharine Lee Rawlings in 1877. [ODNB; Henry and Katharine Jenner ed.

Derek R.

Williams (London: Francis Boutle 2004)]
